The '''Orkellia system''' was a part of the [[Haserian sector/Legends|Haserian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creature known as [[Orkellian cave slug]].<ref name="PoD" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Orkellia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" />
